api-url.tooltip: Base URL of Clankermux's public widget API, for example http://127.0.0.1:8080 or http://clankermux.example.test:8080

connection-note.description: The applet reads Clankermux's unauthenticated, read-only /public/v1 status, accounts, runway, pacing, and workload-headroom endpoints. Enter a complete HTTP or HTTPS URL above; hostnames and IP addresses are both supported.

panel-bar-width.description: Width of each panel pace bar

show-panel-percentages.description: Show exact headroom beside workload bars

runway-warning-hours.description: Warn in the popup when quota runway falls below
runway-warning-hours.tooltip: This affects the secondary runway detail. The panel headline follows pace headroom instead.

show-scoped-limits.description: Show model-family headroom and limits in the panel and popup

default-candidate-first.description: Put the default routing candidate first
default-candidate-first.tooltip: This is the account selected for a fresh, unpinned, nominal-sized request; pinned and affinity-routed requests may choose differently.
